configuration.gradient_fd_error_norm: infinity norm of AD-FD divided by infinity norm of FD; every supported route
configuration.graph_queries: all nodes; last node is absorbing reference target
configuration.informational_cpu_memory_scope: Provider-managed memory, not bounded by Phydrax planning
configuration.nonfinite_json_representation: null means an invalid numerical result, never a successful fallback
configuration.reference_row_normalization: Exact mpmath normalization of the same affinities supplied to the package
configuration.timing: Separate preparation/lowering/compilation and warmed solve; two absorbing query targets, warm time divided by query_count.

G1_accuracy.criterion: Package phi and expected-cost componentwise relative errors <= 1e-8 against exactly normalized 90-digit mpmath; status SUCCESS.

G2_conditioning.criterion: Package Newton Jacobian cond2 < 1e12 and status SUCCESS at every strictly positive theta.

G3_limits.criterion: theta=1e5 phi/shortest error <= 1e-4; theta=1e-9 cost/hitting and commute-identity errors <= 1e-5; status SUCCESS.
G3_limits.hypotheses: Almost-sure absorption; reversible commute cost equals cost-volume times resistance.

G4_scaling.criterion: Default package status SUCCESS, independent reference errors <= 1e-7, warm per-target solve time < 30 seconds.
